resources.string: Enter the upstream Remote MFi service URL using HTTP or HTTPS. Enter a token only if required by the service. Availability is checked when connecting.
Paste the token provided by the service
Could not save remote settings. Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL. Tokens cannot contain null characters. Credentials, query parameters and fragments in the URL are not supported.
Authentication is unavailable. Import valid credentials.
Changing authentication ends the current CarPlay session. Reconnect from the connection page after saving.
Paste a matching certificate and private key in PEM or Base64 format. They will be saved and enabled after validation.
This build does not include built-in credentials. Use quick text import.
Could not enable authentication. Check the text format, that the P-256 private key matches a single certificate, and that device storage is writable.
